description: Put a wiki page in its space's ARCHIVE (archived: true) or return it to the tree (archived: false). An archived page and every page beneath it leave the page tree for the space's «Archive»: still readable at their address and in search, closed to every edit until returned. Archiving needs the right to edit the page; the home page cannot be archived. Returning takes the page that was archived — a page that went with its parent comes back with it — under its old parent, or at the top of the space when that parent is gone.

archived.description: true to archive, false to return it from the archive.

name: archive_wiki_page
title: Archive wiki page
